notes.title: Fasaria World Online: Now Play for FREE!
notes.content:
The new free trial has been released and you can now try the game for free. Build your colony and character, battle other players and climb the ranks. Create a free account on our trial server and test the game out before you buy.

[b]Major updates include:[/b]
[list]
[*]Version 2.0 upgrade (level up beyond 120, new quests, build a starship)
[*]Steam achievements can now be earned
[*]Secure website update[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/398970

[h1][b]Fasaria World: Ancients of Moons MMORPG DLC[/b][/h1]

We are glad to announce our DLC "Ancients of Moons" which is a full mmorpg experience based upon the Fasaria World Online game and story. Build your character, your space station and explore Fasaria and her moons in order to discover the secrets behind a growing threat. Learn more about the DLC here.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/515800/?snr=1_5_1100__1100

notes.title: Fasaria World 2.0 is Finally Here!
notes.content:
Fasaria World 2.0 is now here with many new fixes, changes, updates and additions! Listed below are all of the new features to the game everyone can now enjoy. If you have an account already, log in to check out all of our new features. If you don't have an account, now is the best time to get the game and join the community.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/398970/ss_eedf0240d63f9f022315ba5c3e201b5244d24fbe.1920x1080.jpg?t=1457239836[/img]

*Be sure to exit your browser window and clear the cache (all files and history) so all images will update. 
[list]
[*]New Battle System added
[*]Level Cap Increased to 120 with new starship levels
[*]Quests and Missions added to allow leveling beyond level 120
[*]New Weapons and Armor
[*]Chat Box has been updated
[*]New Character Badges appear in profile and chat
[*]New PVP badges
[*]You can now click character avatar to view profile info
[*]Ranking list updated
[*]Army Management Upgraded
[*]PVP now reserved for armies only (now with new page)
[*]Assembly Factory System upgraded
[*]Engineering Lab Upgraded
[*]New Trade Market
[*]Advanced Hire Upgraded
[*]Achievements Upgraded
[*]New Elite Sponsor Rankings List
[*]Resource display upgraded
[*]Avatars upgraded[/list]

notes.title: February Newsletter: A Lot of Updates Coming!
notes.content:
We have a lot of major updates on the way for all of our games so keep a look out.

[h1][b]Fasaria World Online:[/b][/h1]

A lot of major changes to the game and a major overhaul of some features are in the works, expect to see a full update to the game very soon.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria RPG:[/b][/h1]

We are working on a new version of Angels of Fasaria RPG from the ground up. This new version will be released as a stand alone game and it is TOTALLY different in comparison from the current version. A lot of major changes and improvements will be included to this newer version so it will be sold as a new game. We are still considering creating a browser based mmo to accompany that version but no absolute decision has been made yet.

[h1][b]Angels of Fasaria Online:[/b][/h1]

We still have sign ups open for alpha testing for the online game version of Angels of Fasaria. Not a lot of people have signed up or shown interest so development is currently halted. If you want to see the online game be made, sign up and show your support for it. Currently, you can sign up on steam but private testing may occur which will require an NDA and participation will be outside of steam until the game is ready for beta testing.

[h1][b]AoF Chess Club 2.0:[/b][/h1]

Some nice updates are scheduled for AoF Chess Club 2.0, mainly the translated versions which should open the community to players from around the world. More info soon.

[h1][b]AoF World Online:[/b][/h1]

We have a community edition in the works which will include the server with scripts for all players to be able to launch and play locally on their computer. We will also open up the workshop giving players freedom to edit and submit their modified versions. This should open this game to the community for further development and growth as we are no longer developing this game.

The partner dlc will allow players to host their own server where trial players will have access to play on for free. Active servers will have the opportunity to migrate to our list of servers reserved for paid players.

notes.title: NSE Circuit November Newsletter
notes.content:
Busy, busy, busy. We have a lot going on in November to talk about. Fasaria World Online is expected to release this month on November 5th and Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club on November 4th. Be sure to get the games if you haven't already. We've also just recently added a new web launcher for each game that makes accessing them from steam a snap. Here are some of the updates and changes to look out for.

Fasaria World Online Updates:

1. We have removed the ability to purchase crystals from our online shop and instead replaced it with an "Elite Sponsorship Package" option.

2. ALL players now will receive 50 crystonian crystals every month for free. Crystals have already been added to all accounts this month so log in and spend it!

Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club Updates:

1. We've added the ability to select up to 5 different chess piece styles and 5 different board colors.

2. We added a chat box for each club.

3. We added a match making lobby where you can now organize matches.

Angels of Fasaria 2.0 Updates:

We are still looking for players to volunteer for testing our upcoming mmo for Angels of Fasaria. If you have the game in your inventory, you qualify to join early testing so sign up on the discussion board.

That's all for now. We have a lot of more updates and good news coming soon, so always check in NSE Circuit for all your latest news and updates.

http://nsecircuit.com

notes.title: New Game Launcher Update
notes.content: We added a new game launcher for Fasaria World Online and Ancients of Fasaria Chess Club. This new launcher is a lot better and more stable. It will also allow you to launch either game directly from the launcher's browser without having to leave the interface or launch out of a new browser. This will make both games a lot more accessible for steam users. Make sure you log out of steam client and then log back in for the full update.
